subject: English
question_text: Read the beginning of a story. Write ten new sentences
stimulus: to complete the story. 1×10=10 Belal was an SSC Examinee. He was not attentive to his lessons especially to English. He did not read regularly. So his preparation in English was not good, one month before of his examination he managed a short suggestion of probable questions on English. On the day of Examination of English he started for the examination hall a bit earlier. He entered the examination hall with a trembling heart. As a result the bell rang............ .
guide_solution: Story writing  Title : The Idle Suffer in the long run See Laksam Pilot High School, Comilla. Sl. No. 85; Page No. 132
